text: dsh-workspace-hide 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的工作区显示管理插件，在设置页提供工作区开关并过滤侧边栏列表。关闭某行可隐藏该工作区，并把其中原先未归档的会话收起，避免它们落入未分组列表；重新显示时恢复这次归档的会话。支持逐项切换、显示全部、失效记录清理和恢复失败重试。隐藏清单保存在浏览器本地，工作区文件和会话记录不被删除。需要实际归档与恢复时，需有提供取消归档能力的 archive-manager。

dsh-workspace-hide adds workspace switches to DSH Web Settings. Hidden workspaces leave the sidebar and their sessions stay out of the ungrouped list. Showing them restores sessions archived by that action. The list is stored in browser localStorage; host archiving needs an unarchive service.
想把不常用的工作区从 DSH 侧边栏收起来。
DSH 隐藏工作区后，怎么避免它的会话跑到未分组？
能不能在设置里逐个控制哪些工作区显示？
我想临时隐藏工作区，需要时再把它和会话恢复。
How can I hide selected workspaces from the DSH sidebar?
I want workspace conversations kept out of the ungrouped list when I hide a workspace.
dsh-workspace-hide 的功能「工作区侧边栏显隐」：在设置页切换工作区开关，隐藏项从侧边栏列表移除并沉到管理列表底部；再次打开可恢复显示。
dsh-workspace-hide 的功能「隐藏时收起会话」：插件把该工作区中尚未归档的会话标记为隐藏，并在具备恢复能力时调用宿主归档；恢复时只处理本次隐藏归档的会话。
dsh-workspace-hide 的功能「批量恢复与失败重试」：设置页的“显示全部”恢复所有隐藏工作区及相关会话；取消归档失败的会话可重试或从待恢复列表移除。
dsh-workspace-hide 的功能「本地保存隐藏清单」：插件将隐藏工作区及归档会话 ID 写入浏览器 localStorage，并支持从旧版清单迁移。
dsh-workspace-hide 使用前须知：只有检测到提供取消归档能力的 workspaceRegistry 时，才会把会话真正归档到宿主；缺少该能力时仅在侧边栏隐藏显示，取消隐藏即可显示回来。
隐藏工作区时能不能把它的会话一起从侧栏收起来？
Can I restore only the conversations that were archived when I hid a workspace?

dsh-workspace-hide README · dsh-workspace-hide：> English: [`README.en.md`](./README.en.md)

在 DSH 侧边栏**隐藏指定工作区**，连同它名下的会话一起收进「归档」，并在
「设置 → 工作区显示」里随时恢复。

纯本地、可逆、不删数据：工作区文件夹和会话记录始终留在磁盘上。

---

dsh-workspace-hide README · 它解决什么：DSH 内置的「删除工作区」其实也不删数据，但它的心智负担是"移出列表"，恢复要重新添加文件夹。
更麻烦的是：**任何只把工作区从列表里摘掉的做法，都会让它的会话掉进侧边栏的「未分组」**，
变成一堆无主的条目（根因见 [`DESIGN.md` §1.1](./DESIGN.md#11-两层配合)）。

本插件同时处理这两件事：

- 侧边栏不再出现该工作区；
- 它名下的会话**不会**变成一堆无主的「未分组」条目，而是被归档收起来；
- 撤销隐藏时，只有"因为这次隐藏才被归档"的会话会回来。

**隐藏之前就已经归档的会话，永远不会被这次隐藏/恢复碰到。**

dsh-workspace-hide README · 使用：1. 安装后重启 DSH Desktop；
2. 打开 **设置**，左侧栏出现「**工作区显示**」（排在「归档会话」之后）；
   导航栏容不下长标签，所以那里的名字是短的，面板内标题仍写全：「侧边栏显示的工作区」；
3. 每行右侧一个开关，**打开 = 在侧边栏显示，关掉 = 隐藏并归档其会话**；
   关掉后该行自动沉到列表底部，并显示「已归档 N 个会话」；
4. 顶部显示「共 N 个 · 显示 N 个 · 隐藏 N 个」，点「全部显示」一键清空清单并批量恢复。

被隐藏的工作区**不会**从设置页消失——设置页读的是未过滤列表，否则就没法撤销了。
隐藏行上会显示「已归档 N 个会话」，让你知道恢复时会回来多少。

> 开关的默认状态是「打开」：新装插件时什么都没被隐藏，因此每一行都是显示的。
> 这套语义下不存在「新工作区默认消失」的坑——所有工作区默认都在侧边栏，只有你手动关掉的行才会藏起来。

> 卸载或清空清单之前，请先点一次「全部显示」，否则被归档的会话会留在「归档」页里。

---

dsh-workspace-hide README · 从 npm 安装（推荐）：```powershell
dsh plugin add dsh-workspace-hide@0.2.1
```

dsh-workspace-hide README · 从 GitHub 安装：```powershell
dsh plugin add https://codeload.github.com/SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.2.1
```

`dsh plugin add` 本质就是在 profile 目录（`~/.dsh/profiles/web`）里跑一次 `pnpm add`，
并**同时**把包名写进 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles` 两处；`dsh plugin remove`
会把两处一起清掉。

各种目标形式的实测结果：

dsh-workspace-hide README · 从 GitHub 安装：| 形式 | 命令 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| **npm（推荐）** | `dsh plugin add dsh-workspace-hide@0.2.1` | 最短；只依赖 `registry.npmjs.org`，不碰 `github.com` |
| **tarball** | `dsh plugin add https://codeload.github.com/SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.2.1` | 不经过 git，不需要 SSH 密钥，走 `codeload.github.com`；实测 1.6s |
| `git+https` | `dsh plugin add git+https://github.com/SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide.git#v0.2.1` | 走 https git；需要能连上 `github.com:443` |
| `github:` | `dsh plugin add github:SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide#v0.2.1` | ⚠️ **pnpm 会把它解析成 `git+ssh://`**（见下），需要本机已配好 GitHub SSH 密钥与 `known_hosts` |
| 跟随 `main` | `dsh plugin add https://codeload.github.com/SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide/tar.gz/refs/heads/main` | 上游随时会变，不建议 |
| 本地目录（改代码时） | `dsh plugin add file:C:/path/to/dsh-workspace-hide` | ⚠️ **只在安装那一刻物化一份**，之后改源码不会同步（见下） |

dsh-workspace-hide README · 从 GitHub 安装：> **关于 `github:` 形式**：pnpm 对它的解析目标是
> `git+ssh://git@github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git`，所以一台没配过 GitHub SSH 的机器
> 会直接 `Host key verification failed`。tarball 形式没有这个问题。

dsh-workspace-hide README · 从 GitHub 安装：> **关于 `file:` 本地目录形式（改代码必读）**：pnpm 对 `file:` 目录依赖**只在安装那一刻**
> 把文件拷/硬链进 `node_modules`，之后你改源码它一无所知——`node_modules/dsh-workspace-hide`
> 里躺着的仍是安装时的旧快照。实测踩过一次：源码已经改到 43365 B，profile 里那份还是
> 42010 B 的旧文件，重启多少次界面都不变。
>
> 想边改边用，就在装完之后把那份副本换成指向工作副本的**目录联接**（junction，不需要管理员权限）：
>
> ```powershell
> $dst = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-workspace-hide"
> Move-Item $dst "$dst.bak"                                    # 先备份旧副本
> New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $dst -Target "C:/path/to/dsh-workspace-hide"
> ```
>
> 这样改源码后**重启 DSH Desktop** 即生效。注意以后跑 `pnpm install` 或
> `dsh plugin add/remove` 可能把它换回实体拷贝，那时重建一次即可。

dsh-workspace-hide README · 从 GitHub 安装：装完**重启 DSH Desktop**，再打开「设置」，左侧应出现「工作区显示」。

第三方插件建议钉 tag 或 commit，不要跟随 `main`。

dsh-workspace-hide README · 关于依赖：本插件是零依赖的：**没有 npm 依赖，也没有构建步骤。** `lib/client.js` 是手写的
`window.__ModuleLoader__` 工厂，它 `require` 的 `react` 与
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 都由 DSH 运行时**注入**（后者还有 `try/catch`
兜底，取不到就退化成内置控件）。所以这两个包**不是** dependencies，也不该被写进
dependencies —— 那反而可能装进第二份 react 实例。

---

dsh-workspace-hide README · dsh-workspace-hide：**Show or hide workspaces in the DSH sidebar.** Hidden workspaces are removed from the
sidebar and their sessions are collected into the archive, and you can bring any of them
back from **Settings → Workspace visibility** at any time.

Everything is local, reversible, and nothing is deleted: the workspace folder and its
session records always stay on disk.

> 中文文档：[`README.md`](./README.md)

---

dsh-workspace-hide README · The problem：DSH's built-in "remove workspace" does not delete data either, but its mental model is
*"take it out of the list"*, and restoring one means adding the folder again.
Worse: **any approach that merely drops a workspace from the list makes its sessions fall
into the sidebar's "Ungrouped" section**, turning them into a pile of ownerless entries
(root cause: [`DESIGN.md` §1.1](./DESIGN.md#11-两层配合), in Chinese).

This plugin handles both halves at once:

dsh-workspace-hide README · The problem：- the workspace no longer appears in the sidebar;
- its sessions do **not** become a pile of ownerless "Ungrouped" entries — they are
  collected into the archive instead;
- when you unhide it, only the sessions that *"were archived because of this very hide"*
  come back.

**Sessions that were already archived before the hide are never touched by the
hide/restore cycle.**

dsh-workspace-hide README · Usage：A hidden workspace does **not** disappear from the settings page — that page reads the
unfiltered list, otherwise there would be no way to undo the hide. Hidden rows show
"N sessions archived" so you can tell how many will come back.

> The switch defaults to **on**: a freshly installed plugin has nothing hidden, so every
> row is shown. Under this model there is no "newly created workspaces vanish by default"
> trap — every workspace is in the sidebar unless you switch its row off yourself.

dsh-workspace-hide README · Usage：> Before uninstalling or clearing the list, click **"Show all"** once; otherwise the
> archived sessions stay on the "Archived" page.

---

dsh-workspace-hide README · From npm (recommended)：```powershell
dsh plugin add dsh-workspace-hide@0.2.1
```

dsh-workspace-hide README · From GitHub：```powershell
dsh plugin add https://codeload.github.com/SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.2.1
```

`dsh plugin add` is essentially `pnpm add` run inside the profile directory
(`~/.dsh/profiles/web`), and it writes the package name into **both** `dependencies` and
`dsh.profile.bundles`; `dsh plugin remove` clears both.

Measured behaviour of each target form:

dsh-workspace-hide README · From GitHub：| Form | Command | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **npm (recommended)** | `dsh plugin add dsh-workspace-hide@0.2.1` | Shortest; only needs `registry.npmjs.org`, never touches `github.com` |
| **tarball** | `dsh plugin add https://codeload.github.com/SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.2.1` | No git, no SSH key, goes through `codeload.github.com`; measured 1.6s |
| `git+https` | `dsh plugin add git+https://github.com/SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide.git#v0.2.1` | Uses https git; needs `github.com:443` reachable |
| `github:` | `dsh plugin add github:SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide#v0.2.1` | ⚠️ **pnpm resolves this to `git+ssh://`** (see below); needs a working GitHub SSH key and `known_hosts` |
| Track `main` | `dsh plugin add https://codeload.github.com/SUZUNAMI/dsh-workspace-hide/tar.gz/refs/heads/main` | Upstream moves; not recommended |
| Local directory (when editing code) | `dsh plugin add file:C:/path/to/dsh-workspace-hide` | ⚠️ **materialised once at install time**; later source edits do not sync (see below) |

dsh-workspace-hide README · From GitHub：> **About the `github:` form**: pnpm resolves it to
> `git+ssh://git@github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git`, so a machine with no GitHub SSH set up
> fails with `Host key verification failed`. The tarball form has no such problem.

dsh-workspace-hide README · From GitHub：> **About the `file:` local-directory form (must-read if you edit the code)**: for a
> `file:` directory dependency, pnpm copies/hardlinks the files into `node_modules`
> **only at install time** and then never looks at the source again —
> `node_modules/dsh-workspace-hide` keeps the stale snapshot from that moment. This
> bit us once for real: the source had grown to 43365 B while the copy in the profile was
> still the 42010 B file, and no number of restarts changed the UI.
>
> To edit and use the plugin at the same time, replace that copy with a **directory
> junction** pointing at your working copy (a junction needs no administrator rights):
>
> ```powershell
> $dst = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-workspace-hide"
> Move-Item $dst "$dst.bak"                                    # back up the old copy first
> New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $dst -Target "C:/path/to/dsh-workspace-hide"
> ```
>
> After that, editing the source takes effect on the next **restart of DSH Desktop**.
> Note that a later `pnpm install` or `dsh plugin add/remove` may turn it back into a real
> copy; just recreate the junction when that happens

dsh-workspace-hide README · From GitHub：After installing, **restart DSH Desktop**, then open **Settings** — the left rail should
show "Workspace visibility".

Third-party plugins should be pinned to a tag or commit rather than tracking `main`.

dsh-workspace-hide README · About dependencies: this plugin has none：**No npm dependencies and no build step.** `lib/client.js` is a hand-written
`window.__ModuleLoader__` factory, and the `react` and
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` it `require`s are **injected** by the DSH runtime
(the latter also has a `try/catch` fallback that degrades to built-in controls). So those
two packages are **not** dependencies and should not be listed as dependencies — that
could even pull in a second copy of react.

dsh-workspace-hide README · 0.2.1 — documentation only：Plugin behaviour is **unchanged**. This release is documentation:

- New English `README.en.md`, shipped inside the package so the npm page and the
  catalogue page can offer both languages.
- The repository and npm `description` are updated to the "show/hide" wording (they still
  carried the pre-0.2.0 phrasing).
- Install pins in the docs bumped to `0.2.1`.

dsh-workspace-hide README · 0.2.0 — the settings switch now means "shown"：- Renamed: "Hidden workspaces" → panel title **"Workspaces shown in the sidebar"**, with
  the short rail label **"Workspace visibility"** (the rail cannot fit the full sentence
  and truncates it to "Sidebar worksp…"); a description line was added too.
- The switch is inverted: **on = shown, off = hidden**. It used to be
  "ticked = hidden", which read backwards.
- Hidden rows sink to the bottom of the list (stable sort; visible rows keep their
  relative order).
- Counts moved into the summary text: "N total · N shown · N hidden", and
  "N workspaces, all shown" when nothing is hidden.
- Button renamed: "Restore all" → **"Show all"** (enabled only when something is hidden).
- **Nothing changed underneath**: the storage format is still
  `dsh-workspace-hide.hidden.v2` (the same `hidden` list), as are the
  archive/unarchive scope, the `canRestore` hints, stale-entry handling, and
  cross-version migration. The inversion lives in exactly one place
  (`checked: hidden !== true` in `WorkspaceRow`, with `onChange` negating again).

dsh-workspace-hide README · 0.1.3 — release plumbing and docs：Plugin behaviour is **unchanged**. This release switched publishing to GitHub Actions
OIDC trusted publishing (`.github/workflows/release.yml`, no long-lived npm token in the
repository any more) and promoted the npm install path to the recommended one — npm only
needs `registry.npmjs.org`, unlike the tarball/git forms which require `github.com` to be
reachable.

dsh-workspace-hide README · 0.1.2 — first public release：- Hide a workspace from the sidebar; its sessions are merged into `archivedSessionIds`
  and no longer spill into "Ungrouped".
- When `@michengai/dsh-archive-manager` is present, the host layer turns on: real,
  undoable archiving. Without it the plugin degrades to a display-only layer and never
  archives for real (the core has no reverse operation — see `DESIGN.md`).
- Settings page "Hidden workspaces": per-row switch, `canRestore` hints, "remove record"
  for stale entries, "retry restore" after a failed unarchive, "Restore all".
- The list persists to `localStorage` under `dsh-workspace-hide.hidden.v2` (with
  automatic migration from v1).
- Install docs fixed: `github:` gets resolved by pnpm to `git+ssh://`, so the docs now use
  the codeload tarball instead.

dsh-workspace-hide README · More documentation：How it works, its seams, known limits, the offline verification method, and the
source-level evidence from a real machine: [`DESIGN.md`](./DESIGN.md) — **Chinese only**.
